Subject: POC Plan & Success Criteria — Acme Health

Hi Alice / Ben,

Great to meet earlier — thanks for the time and for walking through the primary use cases. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can align the POC scope: 

Summary of needs
- Real-time triage assistant for intake notes (expected latency target <= 800ms).
- Entity extraction for claims metadata (85%+ precision on key fields).
- Redaction/PII controls and private deployment option for PHI flows.

Proposed POC (2 weeks)
- Week 1: Model onboarding + dataset ingest (sample clinical notes, de-identified)
- Week 2: Endpoint tuning, success criteria validation, readout prep

Success criteria (draft)
- Latency: p95 <= 800ms on 512-token sequences
- Extraction: >85% precision / recall on labelled test set
- Integration: demo showing end-to-end flow with their UI and RBAC

Ownership
- Redwood: Marcus (tech lead) + Neha (SE) for onboarding & tuning
- Acme: Alice lead, Ben owner for procurement/IT coordination

Next steps
1) Confirm trial dataset access and expected date for sample export (Alice)
2) Sign MSA/Standard SOW (Procurement) — I'll share updated MAP and the success criteria spreadsheet attached
3) Schedule kickoff (proposed: Mon 09/06 10:00 PT)

I've attached the draft success criteria and an updated mutual action plan for your review. Let me know if the kickoff time works or propose alternatives.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
